resumeText:
Ananya Iyer | Bengaluru | ananya.iyer@example.com

SUMMARY
Technology risk and GRC leader with 15 years in IT audit and GRC at global capability centres.

EXPERIENCE
Associate Director - IT GRC, Northstar Retail Technology Centre, Bengaluru (2020 - present)
- Own the governance, risk and compliance framework and the ISMS policy set.
- Run SOX ITGC and ISO 27001 and SOC 2 programmes across 40 applications.
- Lead technology risk assessment and keep the enterprise risk register.
- Built the vendor risk assessment process for 300 suppliers.
- Coordinate internal audit, external audit and customer audits.
- Own the internal controls testing plan and test of controls results.
- Managed a team of 25 through three GRC managers.
- Use stakeholder communication with IT owners, legal and internal audit.

IT Audit Manager, Big Four firm, Bengaluru (2011 - 2020)
- Led ITGC audits for banking and retail clients.

EDUCATION
BTech Information Technology, PES University, 2011

CERTIFICATIONS
CISA, CRISC
